summary: HVAC/R technician with three years of field experience in commercial refrigeration and residential HVAC installation. Demonstrated ability to diagnose system failures, perform preventive maintenance, and communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: HVAC/R Technician
bullets: Performed diagnostic and repair work on 40+ residential HVAC units monthly, maintaining a 92% first-visit resolution rate.
Completed EPA 608 certification and routinely handle refrigerant recovery in compliance with Section 608 of the Clean Air Act.
Trained two junior technicians on system startup procedures and safety protocols.

experience.title: Apprentice Technician
bullets: Assisted lead technicians on commercial refrigeration installations across 15+ restaurant accounts.
Logged over 1,200 hours of supervised field experience in ductwork, electrical, and refrigerant line work.
